company.source_note:
Triomics builds oncology-specific AI systems designed to integrate directly into cancer center workflows. Their platform uses AI to analyze complex patient data and deliver precision oncology insights. As a healthcare AI company with FDA-regulated medical device implications, they face significant AI compliance requirements (HIPAA, FDA, clinical validation), AI governance for patient-facing AI decisions, and need strong legal infrastructure for healthcare data sharing, research partnerships, and commercialization.
